items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: so we got acquainted altogether again with Louie and I think Trummy Young [with him] was, at this time, and Edmund Hall.

all the important functions of society people and we'd go to Grosse Point, Michigan to play for the Fords and then we'd go to Wilmington to play for the DuPont people. And it was wonderful to see all these people with a lot of bread, they'd throw bread around like there was no more tomorrow, you know. Then we'd take flying trips to Dallas to play for Mr. Hunt who is one of the billionaires in oil in Ft. Worth, Texas. He imported the band over and one time when Lester was booked for the ball in Ft.
